description: This PHP source file defines a class LDAPTestService that extends LDAPService, used for testing LDAP connections and authentication within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to obtain LDAP adapter, test connection, and perform authentication, utilizing certain settings and traits.

classes.name: LDAPTestService
classes.description: A service class for testing LDAP connectivity and authentication, primarily used for validating LDAP settings within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes LDAP settings used for LDAP connection testing.

methods.name: getAdapter
methods.description: Returns an LDAP Adapter instance configured with the specified LDAP settings.

methods.name: testConnection
methods.description: Performs a test connection to LDAP by binding with provided credentials.

methods.name: testAuthentication
methods.description: Tests LDAP authentication and returns a success or failure message and status.
